verdict.rationale: Vanta documents background automation it runs itself: continuous automated tests and evidence collection from connected integrations, a TPRM Agent that discovers and monitors vendors, automated risk reminders and workflows, and an AI Agent that flags issues proactively. Users can also define Custom Tests that turn pushed data into pass/fail evidence. However, the evidence shows no user-facing way to build, schedule, or trigger arbitrary autonomous automations or agents, and the agentic questionnaire workflows still require human review and approval. Missing for 10: a documented user-configurable automation or workflow builder, user-defined triggers or schedules for autonomous agent runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the background automation works as claimed.
